slides.narration: Okay, this is EIGHT Roblox clients, running at the same time, on one PC. And the app doing it is free.
Save all your alts and manage your accounts. One click each, with live status and the game each one is actually in.
Now every account shows its Robux, Plus, and friends online. Open one up, and its games are right there. Recent, favorites, private servers.
And when an account needs you, it says so. Session expired, needs verification, limited by Roblox. One click to fix it.
Every game you've played lands in the Library. Search it, filter it, and pick which account plays.
Squad Launch is the best part. One link, and every single account lands in the SAME private server, together.
And it keeps score! Peak alts at once, total upptime, a leaderboard of your alts with login streaks. All computed on your machine, nothing leaves it.
Four built-in themes, plus a theme builder where an AI designs you a custom one from a vibe description.
Your password never touches the app, ever. And there's a pile of quality of life on top. Just read the list!
Free on the Microsoft Store, Windows AND Mac. Scan the code, save the page, grab it on your desktop. RoRoRo, from six-two-six Labs. Imagine something else.
